verdict.rationale: Clerk is an authentication and user-management service, not an agent or AI application, so consuming tools from plugged-in MCP servers is a category error for this product type. Its MCP-related evidence is all about other roles: it runs its own MCP server, provides OAuth/client registration for MCP clients, and gates eve tool calls. None of that shows Clerk itself acting as an MCP client, so nothing flips the axis to applicable.
